unsupported_annotations.claim: “維持 Cedar 與停用派送”／“維持 Cedar 為預設且不啟用派送”
unsupported_annotations.reason: 證據只說評估 runner 的 dispatch_enabled=false；它不支持將明日正常批次的 dispatcher 持續停用。維持 Cedar 有據，但停用未來批次派送是額外、未論證的操作建議。

contradiction_annotations.reason: The candidate’s actual available summary explicitly says the benchmark was preview-only and that no dispatch occurred, so recording this field as unknown conflicts with available evidence, even though no underlying documents were provided.

unsupported_annotations.claim: “Pennythorn also has ... a 33-minute commute, within your 35-minute maximum.”
unsupported_annotations.reason: The packet supports only a supplied trip/route-sheet figure, not a verified actual commute. The prose does not retain that source-limited qualification.

contradiction_annotations.reason: Mosslantern’s £2,160 estimated all-in cost is £30 above the hard £2,130 ceiling, as the response’s own table acknowledges.

contradiction_annotations.claim: “Give your one viewing slot to Mosslantern”
contradiction_annotations.reason: This conflicts with the hard all-in ceiling and the packet-supported one-slot priority for Pennythorn.

contradiction_annotations.claim: “neither is a clean match: Pennythorn meets the cost cap but is a studio”
contradiction_annotations.reason: The latest user instruction expressly accepts a studio if the desk fits, so studio status is no longer a failed hard requirement.

unsupported_annotations.claim: “the reported 140 cm clear desk wall meets your 130 cm desk requirement”
unsupported_annotations.reason: The agent-plan width supports provisional plausibility, but actual unobstructed fit, depth, furniture, and circulation have not been measured in person. The response later acknowledges these checks, so the initial wording is too definite.

contradiction_annotations.claim: “Keep the Mosslantern viewing” followed by “The source lines that changed the choice”
contradiction_annotations.reason: These statements are internally inconsistent: keeping the same choice and changing the choice cannot both describe the recommendation transition.

unsupported_annotations.claim: “whether a permanent zero-step solution will be installed”
unsupported_annotations.reason: The evidence requires a verified zero-step solution but does not require it to be permanent.

unsupported_annotations.claim: “Do not book or pay at the viewing.”
unsupported_annotations.reason: The user said they would make the booking and asked the assistant not to book; the evidence does not support advising the user categorically not to book or pay.

contradiction_annotations.reason: The source gives Flat 10’s estimated all-in total as £2,010; £2,050 is the user’s ceiling.

accounting: Actual workload counts each shared generation once. Standalone arm pipelines count each dependency once per case/replicate, including initial and update; arm totals overlap and MUST NOT be summed. Judge/calibration cost included in whole-run actual total and shown separately. Joint prose+state generator is charged in full to either standalone arm; not optimized pure-prose production cost.
limitations: Synthetic mechanism study, not statistical equivalence; repeated rental samples share cases and are not independent users.
Shared source-only memory generation/update, with each arm's prior answer separately retained. Does not measure full assistant-history compaction.
Oracle has preregistered gold document IDs and is a diagnostic bound, not a deployable retriever.
Two document lengths and one sample per retrieval cell cannot establish a general crossover curve.
Calibration uses known errors and a bundled prompt+visibility change, not held-out judge accuracy or a visibility-only causal estimate.
CLI costs exclude parent/subagent authoring, reviews and documentation; processed tokens are not billing/quota.
analysis_scope: Descriptive paired contrasts; no p-values or confidence intervals. Primary judge labels remain unchanged; separate source-review reconciliation required.
